`umount`: unmount filesystems.

## Synopsis

<strong>umount</strong> <em>dir</em>...

## Description

<strong>umount</strong> takes away the filesystem mounted at each <em>dir</em> named. A failure is reported on standard error as <strong>umount:</strong> <em>dir</em><strong>:</strong> <em>reason</em> and the rest are still tried.

## Exit status

0 if every one was unmounted (or none was named), 1 if any could not be.

## Notes

Only a mount point is taken, not a device, and there are no options. The kernel mounts and unmounts the bus's disks by itself as they come and go.

## See also

<strong>mount</strong>(1), <strong>df</strong>(1)
